title: Settings
description: Configuration that applies to the whole app and everyone using it.
readOnly: You can view these settings, but only people with the Settings · Edit permission can change them.

general.label: General
general.description: Language, dates and times across the app.

branding.label: Branding
branding.description: Your app's name, logo and browser icon, as everyone sees them.

email.label: Email
email.description: The server that sends sign-up, password reset and other account emails.

finance.label: Finance
finance.description: VAT and the date financial tracking starts.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language for visitors and for people who haven't picked their own in My account.
language.defaultHint: Everyone can still choose their own language.
language.savedDescription: New visitors and people without a preference now see this language.

dateTime.title: Date & time
dateTime.description: Used everywhere dates appear: tables, details, activity and history.
dateTime.dateFormatHint: How days, months and years are written.
dateTime.timeZoneHint: Show everyone the same clock, or each person their own local time.
dateTime.savedDescription: Dates across the app now use this format.

branding.appNameHint: Shown in the browser tab, the sidebar and on the public and sign-in pages.
branding.logoHint: Shown in the sidebar and on the public and sign-in pages. A transparent PNG about 200 × 64 px works best.
branding.faviconHint: The small icon in the browser tab. Use a square image, at least 64 × 64 px.
branding.makesPublic: The selected images will be made public, so visitors can see them.
branding.savedDescription: Everyone sees the changes on their next page load.

statusDetail.Pickup: Emails are saved as files (Email:PickupDirectory) instead of being sent.
statusDetail.DevelopmentFolder: Emails are saved to App_Data/emails instead of being sent.
statusDetail.NotConfigured: Emails can't be sent until an SMTP server is set up.

smtp.title: SMTP server
smtp.description: Use your own mail provider (for example Postmark, Amazon SES, Mailgun or Resend) for account emails.
smtp.enabledHint: When this is off, emails go through the server set in the host configuration (SmtpSettings), if there is one.
smtp.incomplete: Enter the host, port and sender address to save.
smtp.senderHint: Who the emails come from. Most providers require a verified address or domain.
smtp.serverHint: The connection details from your mail provider.
smtp.usernameHint: Leave empty if the server doesn't need a sign-in.
smtp.passwordSaved: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
smtp.passwordRemoved: The saved password will be removed when you save.
smtp.savedOn: Account emails are now sent through your SMTP server.

test.title: Send a test email
test.description: Uses the values above, even before you save them, so you can check they work first.
test.sentDescription: Check the inbox, and the spam folder if it isn't there.

finance.readOnly: You can view these settings, but only people with the Finance · Settings permission can change them.

vat.title: VAT
vat.description: The rate new charge lines start with. Each line can still use its own rate, e.g. 0% for exempt work.
vat.rateHint: Existing charges keep the rate they were created with.

trackingStart.title: Financial tracking start
trackingStart.description: From this date on, payments and charges are recorded as they happen. What was still owed on it is entered as opening balances.
trackingStart.dateHint: Payments must be received on or after this date.
trackingStart.changeTitle: This moves the line between history and live records
trackingStart.changeText: Live payments or charges dated before the new date, or opening balances after it, block the change until they're reclassified.
trackingStart.reasonHint: Saved in the audit log with the change.
trackingStart.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. We started recording payments a month earlier
trackingStart.reasonRequired: Say why the tracking start date changes.
